description: List every agent registered for your principal. Use it to audit who can spend from the shared wallet, to find a target_agent_id for revoke_agent or renew_mandate, or to check a mandate before it expires. Returns, per agent: agent_id, created_at, principal_key_version, status (active, expired or revoked), mandate_expiry and limits, plus active_agents against max_agents_per_principal. Needs your agent credentials and the principal_key (argument or X-Principal-Key header). An agent you do not recognise may have been registered with a leaked principal_key: revoke it, or rotate the key.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

principal_key.description: The principal's current principal_key (or X-Principal-Key header)

name: list_agents
title: List the principal's agents
